# Permission matrix

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-permission-matrix.mjs from src/permission-matrix.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

What the API member's ConnectWise security role must grant, per tool and as a role recipe. Module and function names are the rows on **System > Security Roles**. Every level named here must be set to **All**; "My" is not enough for an API member. Endpoints behind each tool are checked against ConnectWise's published OpenAPI document (version 2026.11) by the test suite. Verify the result against a live tenant with `cw_get_my_permissions` or `scripts/check-permissions.mjs`; see [API-MEMBER-SETUP.md](API-MEMBER-SETUP.md).

## Role recipe: MCP Read-Only (`CW_WRITE_MODE=read-only`)

| Module | Function | Add | Edit | Delete | Inquire | Tools |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Companies | Company Maintenance | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_companies`, `cw_get_company`, `cw_list_company_sites` |
| Companies | Configurations | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_get_ticket_configurations`, `cw_search_configurations`, `cw_get_configuration` |
| Companies | Contacts | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_contacts`, `cw_get_contact` |
| Companies | CRM/Sales Activities | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_activities`, `cw_get_activity` |
| Service Desk | Resource Scheduling | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_schedule_entries` |
| Service Desk | Service Tickets | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_tickets`, `cw_get_ticket`, `cw_get_ticket_notes`, `cw_get_ticket_configurations`, `cw_list_boards`, `cw_list_statuses`, `cw_get_project_product_status`, `cw_get_project_purchase_order_lines` |

| Time & Expense | Time Entry | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_time_entries`, `cw_get_time_entry` |
| Sales | Closed Opportunity | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_opportunities`, `cw_get_opportunity` |
| Sales | Opportunity | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_opportunities`, `cw_get_opportunity`, `cw_search_opportunity_forecasts`, `cw_search_opportunity_notes` |

| Sales | Sales Orders | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_sales_orders`, `cw_get_sales_order`, `cw_get_sales_order_products` |
| Finance | Agreements | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_agreements`, `cw_get_agreement`, `cw_get_agreement_additions`, `cw_search_agreement_recaps`, `cw_get_agreement_recap` |
| Finance | Invoicing | None | None | None | **All** | `cw_search_invoices`, `cw_get_invoice` |

Table Setup tables to allow on this role: **Company / Communication Type**, **Inventory / Adjustment Type**, **Inventory / Warehouse**, **Inventory / Warehouse Bin**, **Procurement / Manufacturer**, **Procurement / Product Category**, **Procurement / Product Subcategory**, **Sales / Sales Stage**, **Schedule / Schedule Status**, **Schedule / Schedule Type**, **Service / Priority**, **Service / Service Board**.

Notes:

- cw_get_inventory_on_hand: Only for the whole-instance bin scan; with catalogItemId the catalog permission is enough.
- cw_get_opportunity: Only for a closed opportunity.
- cw_list_boards: Board lists are a setup table in some tenants.
- cw_list_warehouses: Warehouses are a setup table, not a Procurement record.
- cw_search_opportunities: Only to include closed opportunities in results.

Notes:

- cw_close_adjustment: Posts stock movements; reversible only with a counter adjustment.
- cw_create_contact: Resolves the email and phone communication types.
- cw_create_time_entry: Same, for entries against project tickets.
- cw_create_time_entry: Turns the ticket's automatic-email flags off around the create so customers are not emailed; omit if suppressTicketAutoEmail is always false.
- cw_get_inventory_on_hand: Only for the whole-instance bin scan; with catalogItemId the catalog permission is enough.
- cw_get_opportunity: Only for a closed opportunity.
- cw_list_boards: Board lists are a setup table in some tenants.
- cw_list_warehouses: Warehouses are a setup table, not a Procurement record.
- cw_search_opportunities: Only to include closed opportunities in results.
- cw_update_ticket: Changing a ticket to a closed status also needs Service Desk > Close Service Tickets (Edit).
